initial:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one low-detail raster creature design sheet, source art for small game sprites.
Primary request: Design the full first-level enemy cast for a Chinese wuxing survival action game, "荒郊古道" (deserted old road). SIX isolated creatures in a strict THREE columns by TWO rows grid. Create painterly flat-color source illustration, NOT pixel art yet: it will be reduced to 24-32 pixel sprites afterward. Favor extremely strong silhouettes and 3-4 large value shapes per material. Use a modest 1536x1024 landscape canvas if possible.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, no backdrop, no ground, no shadows, no pedestal, no rings. Wide transparent gutters, each character contained in its own equal cell. Keep creatures large within cells but leave at least 12 percent padding.
Composition: game sprite camera, shallow three-quarter top-down, orthographic, full bodies all facing RIGHT / southeast, never straight at viewer. Single neutral action-ready pose, no multiple views, no weapons extending into neighbors. Every creature has a clear foot/contact point near the bottom of its cell.
TOP LEFT: earth SHIYONG, a squat ancient terracotta roadside tomb sentinel, square broad shoulders, oversized chipped ochre clay face, short topknot, compact fists, two short separated feet, two large warm pale eye slots, simple three bands of lamellar armor, no weapon. Heavy rectangular silhouette, tan clay and purple-brown shadows. Not a toy robot.
TOP CENTER: wood TENGGUAI, a wild thorn root demon, asymmetric knotted chunky root body with one large split ivory wood mask, three thick ROOT legs well-separated, TWO big hooked vine arms, a few large sage green leaves growing from its head; dark forest green and old pale wood. Broad low claw-like silhouette, threatening regeneration plant rather than cute round green slime. No tiny leaves or spirals.
TOP RIGHT: water SHUIGUI, fast drowned roadside ditch ghost, long dark indigo wet hair swept behind, oversized pale celadon face turned right with dark eye sockets, dark blue torn robe tapering into ONE bent hooked water tail, one stretched claw hand, S-curve forward leaning silhouette, opaque solid colors (no translucent blur). Face and pale sleeve should survive shrinking.
BOTTOM LEFT: fire HUOYA, a small dangerous ember crow flying right, readable pointed crow beak, short compact charcoal-plum body, TWO broad angular wings in raised pose with LARGE burnt orange feather blocks, a large pale yellow-orange ember crop on breast to signal death explosion, short flame-shaped tail integrated with body. Winged triangular silhouette, no loose sparks or flame effects.
BOTTOM CENTER: metal TIEJIA, an empty haunted ancient Chinese iron cuirass soldier, tall helmet with one broad faded red plume, very dark hollow face, pale steel shoulder plate, one broad wedge-shaped spear held FORWARD on diagonal to right, compact closed legs, angular white-gray metal surfaces with blue-gray shadows and dark red sash. Distinctly taller and narrower than terracotta guardian, dash-ready wedge silhouette. No busy scale pattern.
BOTTOM RIGHT: metal LANGYAO boss, a menacing low lunging white-gray WOLF demon on FOUR paws, broad iron-blade mane shaped as three large swept-back spikes, huge hooked foreclaws, long angular muzzle, bright amber eye, one broken rust-red neck ribbon, heavy front shoulders and long tail curving behind. No armor suit, no humanoid stance. Diagonal prowling wolf silhouette. This boss will be shown roughly twice as large as a regular enemy in game.
Style: hand-painted 2D Chinese folklore monster sprite concept illustration, chunky expressive proportions, ominous but charming adventure-game craft, crisp clean outer contours, warm dark plum outline, broad cel-shaded colors, upper-left light, very sparse internal detailing. Six creatures share one consistent art direction.
Constraints: exactly six creatures in assigned cells, no text, no labels, no border, no grid lines, no scenery, no gradients, no ambient glow, no particles, no soft edges, no icons, no tile floors. Keep transparent spaces between all silhouettes. Do not simulate pixel squares or a code-drawn appearance.
refinement:
Use case: background-extraction
Edit the provided six-monster sheet into a clean extraction-ready game sprite source sheet.
Keep the SIX monster identities, order, colors, right-facing poses, materials, and broad silhouette designs exactly recognizable. Keep three columns and two rows on a landscape 1536x1024 sheet.
CHANGE ONLY their spacing/scale and the background, and simplify small texture:
1. Completely REMOVE all colored backdrop, mist, glow, gradients and shadows to TRUE transparent alpha. Empty pixels must have alpha zero. If real alpha cannot be emitted, use ONLY absolutely flat pure #FF00FF as the backdrop. No checkerboard baked into the image.
2. Equal grid cells at x 0-512, 512-1024, 1024-1536 and y 0-512, 512-1024. Scale every creature down within its cell so its entire silhouette including weapon and tail fits inside the central 72% of that cell. At least 60 px transparent space between silhouettes and every grid line. Bottom row spear must be entirely inside its own center cell; wolf tail entirely inside right cell. Do not draw grid lines.
3. Keep bold large clean color regions, remove tiny surface scratches and tiny hair strands. Do not add fine line detail. This is a low-detail source illustration destined to be shrunk to 24-32px sprites. Eyes, masks, beak, weapon are oversized simple readable features.
4. No ground, no rings, no labels, no text, no borders. Six isolated fully-contained silhouettes.
